noun_definition: mweb-emoticon refers to an emoji badge that is applied to messages in the mWeb interface, which should appear greyed out when the message is sent while offline, indicating that it cannot be used in that context.

Emoji badge refers to a visual indicator associated with a message that signifies the use of an emoji in a conversation, which should appear greyed out when the message is sent offline after being sent online.
Message refers to the text communication sent by a user in the application, which can have an emoji badge applied to it.
